title: Reproduce off-panel action-menu click under Wine
platforms: Windows GNU build under Wine, Xvfb and Vulkan llvmpipe
changes: Record an isolated application-window click and no-click control for the recognized action-menu miss.
validation: Actual XTest click at (3,3) generated four frames of A and opened the movement grid; the no-click control kept the menu. Both recordings began at identical state/frame/clock and individually passed final-state/clock replay verification; ROM, original save, snapshot and executable hashes unchanged.
limitations: Control and click runs had different durations; exact window-event frame was not independently captured. One EUR scene, no partial-reveal event, patched build or native Windows. First control script failed and its incomplete recording was retained.
Managed cleanup rejects non-rom-data U31 units; evidence and the interrupted control remain isolated.
